description: Source code implementing template functions and converters for extracting and processing values, files, directories, labels, and dependencies in a build system context.

classes.name: RelativeFileConverter
classes.description: Converts a Value to a SourceFile relative to the current directory.

classes.name: LibFileConverter
classes.description: Converts a Value to a LibFile, handling framework dependencies.

classes.name: RelativeDirConverter
classes.description: Converts a Value to a SourceDir relative to the current directory.

classes.name: ExternConverter
classes.description: Converts a scope Value to a pair of crate name and LibFile.

classes.name: LabelResolver
classes.description: Resolves a string Value to a Label.

classes.name: LabelPtrResolver
classes.description: Resolves a string Value to a LabelPtrPair, leaving the pointer null.

classes.name: LabelPatternResolver
classes.description: Resolves a Value to a LabelPattern.

methods.name: ExtractListOfStringValues
methods.description: Extracts a list of strings from a Value.

methods.name: ExtractListOfRelativeFiles
methods.description: Extracts a list of SourceFile objects relative to a directory.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLibs
methods.description: Extracts a list of LibFile objects.

methods.name: ExtractListOfRelativeDirs
methods.description: Extracts a list of SourceDir objects.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLabels
methods.description: Extracts a list of Labels associated with targets.

methods.name: ExtractListOfUniqueLabels
methods.description: Extracts a list of unique Labels, Configs, or Target pairs.

methods.name: ExtractRelativeFile
methods.description: Extracts a single SourceFile relative to a directory.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLabelPatterns
methods.description: Extracts a list of LabelPattern objects.

methods.name: ExtractListOfExterns
methods.description: Extracts a list of external dependencies as crate name and LibFile pairs.
